verdict.rationale: Authy's features page names the Apple Watch as a supported device ('your phone, tablet, even your Apple Watch'), which directly backs reading codes on a smartwatch. This is a single marketing mention covering only Apple's watch, with no detail on how codes appear on the watch or whether it works without the phone. missing for 10: documentation of watch-side code viewing and how it relates to the phone, non-Apple smartwatch (e.g. Wear OS) support, independent or hands-on corroboration that the watch app works.
